text:
Seems Google doesn't want any other AI touching Google Workspace except through the limited MCP tools they just shipped to GA. The same MCP tools which can't send an email or share a Drive file (in order to protect you).

Thinking back to why I was fired for making gws cli, it was likely an unstated strategy to block AI competition and find a way to meter usage of Google Workspace APIs. The type of strategy that isn't written down or shared.

This effectively locks Gmail, Calendar, Drive, etc to Gemini. I bet Apple gets an exception. What about Superhuman? Muse? Grok Bot?

And dropped on Thanksgiving week the day after Jensen was back at Nvidia.

We need an ArtCraft moment for Google Workspace. Can probably skip Docs and Slides.
